title: Ottawa Tulip Festival Scenic Tour 1 hour 30 minutes
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries

cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover Ottawa’s vibrant Tulip Festival through a unique photo experience, set against the backdrop of over one million blooming tulips at Commissioners Park and Dow’s Lake. This guided tour leads you to the most picturesque spots, allowing you to capture stunning images while learning about the festival's rich history and its ties to the Dutch Royal Family. Stroll through beautifully arranged gardens and enjoy the leisurely atmosphere of spring in Ottawa, ensuring unforgettable memories. After your photo adventure, relax during the return drive to your chosen location.

- Guided private tour of Ottawa's Tulip Festival with expert insights
- Visit Commissioners Park and Dow’s Lake, home to over a million tulips
- Capture stunning photographs at the best floral installations
- Enjoy round-trip transport from your selected location in Ottawa
